Write the memory of events since the most recent memory system notification. Speak in the first person from your own perspective. Preserve concrete details — file paths, exact values, decisions, unresolved questions, the user's active asks. Target ~2000 tokens. Output only the memory body — no preamble, no section headers unless they help preservation, no meta-commentary about summarizing. Memorize only what actually happened in that slice: if it holds little beyond routine system traffic (heartbeats, empty turns, failure notices), a short memory saying so is correct — do not pad it by re-narrating events you already remember from earlier as if they had just happened again.
